Chipotle on Instagram: "calling all MVPs 🗣️📣 wear any hockey jersey TODAY 4/20 after 3PM local time to close & get a BOGO 

valid only on April 20, 2026 after 3PM local time to close. in-restaurant only.
terms: chipotle.com/hockey-bogo"
content.text: calling all MVPs 🗣️📣 wear any hockey jersey TODAY 4/20 after 3PM local time to close & get a BOGO valid only on April 20, 2026 after 3PM local time to close. in-restaurant only.terms: chipotle.com/hockey-bogoNo the goal is my mouth, puck is the food, hockey stick is a spoon or my hands to eat burritoThis “promo” left a bad taste in my mouth. There are versions of your promo floating around, including your own IG, stating this is valid for 4/20 or 4/21. Showed the employees the misleading info and they said it’s only valid for 4/20 and nothing they could do. Wasted my time and looked like a fool going in my hockey jersey.the way chipotle bowl is the real MVP after a long study sesh 🏒🌯 this promo hits differentPlease do this again on WednesdayI got mine wearing a polo lol thanksUntil you hear that their chicken is bagged, pre-marinated chicken that goes through processers to make thier chicken thicker incorporating additives. 👎🏽 I used to like chipotle but man we can’t eat nothing in peace anymore. These fast food chains are corrupted.My team played well but we didn’t get that win. Can we extend the BOGO one more day?Can you bring back the Chimichurri pls?My chipotle was closed today!! Where’s my BOGO? Burbank, CA
